epistemic_role: Independent precision replication; does not replace or retroactively modify the confirmatory 10000-run result.
secondary_estimands: H7 score-state by numerical-state by phase interactions

precision_rule.rationale: At n=50000 the worst-case binomial 95% half-width is approximately 0.00438.

replication_consistency_rule.direction_must_match: Real Best XI champion probability greater than Synthetic XI champion probability
replication_consistency_rule.difference_test: absolute difference between baseline and replication Synthetic XI estimates must not exceed 1.96 times the square root of the sum of their binomial Monte Carlo variances
replication_consistency_rule.interpretation: This is a Monte Carlo consistency check, not a test of real-world truth.

mandatory_integrity_gates: critical source hashes equal the authorized hashes
H5 H6 H7 estimands are present
